title: Coat Of Many Colors
description: In the Smoky Mountains of Tennessee in 1955, a young Dolly Parton grows up in a large, poor family. Her mother sews her a patchwork coat from rags, and Dolly wears it proudly even when classmates tease her. Meanwhile a family tragedy tests her parents' marriage and their faith.

title: 9 to 5
description: Three office workers (Jane Fonda, Lily Tomlin and Dolly Parton) are fed up with their sexist, lying boss. Through a chain of mishaps they end up holding him captive at his own house. With him out of the way, they quietly run the company themselves and make the office a far better place to work.

title: Toy Story 5
description: Woody, Buzz, Jessie and the rest of the toys face a new kind of rival when Lilypad, a tablet, shows up in Bonnie's life. The gadget has its own ideas about how a kid should spend playtime. The toys have to work out whether old-fashioned play still has a place as screens take over.

title: Steel Magnolias
description: In a small Louisiana town, a close group of women meets regularly at the local beauty salon. The story follows them through weddings, births and arguments, and centers on a young diabetic bride (Julia Roberts) whose risky pregnancy worries her mother (Sally Field). When tragedy hits, the friends lean on each other with humor and grit.

title: The Philadelphia Story
description: Wealthy socialite Tracy Lord (Katharine Hepburn) is about to marry for the second time. Then her charming ex-husband (Cary Grant) arrives along with a tabloid reporter (James Stewart) and a photographer. Over one chaotic, champagne-soaked night before the wedding, Tracy has to rethink who she really is and whom she wants to marry.

title: The Last Sunrise
description: Ry, a college student with a chronic illness, spends a summer in Mallorca with her mother and unexpectedly falls for a local young man, Julián. As she learns to live in the moment, her health gets worse and buried family secrets come to light. Directed by Carlson Young from Anna Todd's novel, starring Maia Reficco and Eva Longoria.

title: Famous Last Words: Gloria Steinem
description: An episode of Netflix's Famous Last Words series: a 46-minute interview Gloria Steinem recorded in February 2025, held for release until after her death. She talks openly about founding Ms. magazine, her loves and family, conflicts inside the feminist movement and her regrets, and ends with a message to the next generation.

title: Pretty Woman
description: Edward (Richard Gere), a ruthless corporate raider visiting Los Angeles, pays Vivian (Julia Roberts), a spirited Hollywood Boulevard escort, to spend a week as his companion at business and social events. As she navigates his world of luxury and he loosens up in her company, real affection grows, and both must decide whether a romance across such different lives can last.

title: Good Fortune
description: Gabriel (Keanu Reeves), a well-meaning but bumbling guardian angel, tries to teach a struggling gig worker (Aziz Ansari) a lesson by swapping his life with that of a wealthy venture capitalist (Seth Rogen). The plan backfires in unexpected ways in this comedy about money, class, and what makes a life good. Ansari also wrote and directed.

title: Delicious
description: In France in 1789, just before the Revolution, the gifted cook Manceron is dismissed by his aristocratic employer for serving an unapproved dish and withdraws to a run-down roadside inn. A mysterious woman arrives asking to learn from him, and with her help he rediscovers his love of cooking. Together they open an eatery for ordinary people, presented as the birth of the public restaurant. (French, with subtitles.)

title: People Will Talk
description: Dr. Noah Praetorius (Cary Grant) is a beloved, unconventional physician and medical school lecturer who believes in treating the whole patient. A resentful colleague digs into his mysterious past to get him dismissed, while Praetorius falls for and marries a young student who is pregnant and unmarried. A witty Joseph L. Mankiewicz comedy-drama that takes aim at small-minded gossip.

title: Yacht Rock: A Documentary
description: This HBO documentary traces the smooth West Coast soft rock of the late 1970s and early 1980s, from artists like Michael McDonald, Kenny Loggins, Christopher Cross, Steely Dan and Toto. It follows the genre from chart success, to backlash, to its comeback as the beloved 'yacht rock' label that took off after a 2005 web parody series.

title: The Whisper Man
description: When his young son is abducted, a grieving crime novelist reluctantly asks for help from his estranged father, a retired police detective. Their search points to a decades-old unsolved case involving a child killer known as 'The Whisper Man.' Adapted from Alex North's bestselling thriller novel.

title: Play Misty For Me
description: Dave Garver (Clint Eastwood), a late-night DJ in Carmel, California, has a one-night stand with Evelyn, a listener who keeps calling the station to request the song 'Misty.' Her attachment turns into a dangerous obsession that threatens his career, his relationship and finally his life. Eastwood's first film as director.
